svg.title: Schematic pulsar magnetosphere
svg.desc: Half of an aligned pulsar magnetosphere in a plane containing the rotation axis (left edge), with the star at the lower left. Closed dipolar field lines form the hatched co-rotating magnetosphere, whose outer edge touches the light cylinder, a dashed vertical line. Open field lines leave the polar cap, within an angle theta_0 of the axis, and run out into the wind zone beyond the light cylinder. The upper open line carries electrons, the lower one protons, and the critical line between them reaches the light cylinder at the end of a thin dashed line along which minus and plus signs mark the charges of the plasma.

g.font-family: 'Latin Modern Math', 'STIX Two Math', 'Cambria Math', serif
